summary_bullets: Strengthen /design Step 3 guidance so result-file polling cannot bypass task lifecycle completion.
Add a shared NEVER rule for result-file sleep loops after background launches.
Pin the new /design and shared-orchestrator literals in the anti-polling harness.
commit_message:
Fixes #4110: Pin Step 3 result-file polling ban

Strengthen both /design Step 3 background-review fences so they ban polling .step3-review-result.env before the task notification.

Add the shared orchestrator NEVER rule for run_in_background result-file sleep loops and extend the anti-polling harness to pin both new literals.
